name: @anylisten/android-js
description: Any Listen Android 移植层的 JS 侧（零改动复用 source/packages 下的上游源码）

scripts.build: pnpm run link-vendor && pnpm run clean:spa && pnpm run copy-wasm && vite build && pnpm run shrink-assets
scripts.build:extension-preload: pnpm run clean:ext && vite build --config vite.extension-preload.config.mjs
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:extension-preload
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:all && pnpm run smoke
